source_caption_text:
The only bad thing about this song is that it ends 🤒😔

Juice WRLD’s “Empty” is one of the more emotionally direct songs on Death Race for Love, using a relatively simple production to leave plenty of space for his vocals and lyrics. Released in 2019 as the album’s opening track, the song immediately establishes the darker and more introspective side of the project, with its looping piano melody and steady drums creating a melancholic atmosphere.

Throughout the song, Juice WRLD reflects on feeling emotionally unfulfilled and trying to deal with those feelings in unhealthy ways. His lyrics move between personal thoughts, relationships, and substance use, while his melodic delivery keeps the performance feeling vulnerable rather than overly polished. The contrast between the calm instrumental and the weight of what he is saying is a big part of what makes the track connect with listeners.

“Empty” also shows why Juice WRLD’s music resonated so strongly with his audience. He had a way of turning complicated emotions into simple, memorable melodies without losing the personal side of the writing. As the opening track of Death Race for Love, it sets up many of the themes that appear throughout the album and remains a memorable example of Juice combining melodic rap with deeply personal songwriting.
